clips.title: The story
paras: In Loch Modan, Dark Iron saboteurs threaten the Stonewrought Dam. Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII needs the charge disarmed before the loch floods the lowlands.

Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII saw Dark Iron Insurgents swim toward the base of the Stonewrought Dam with a keg of explosive Seaforium. No Mountaineers were nearby to stop them, and the infiltrators fastened the keg against the dam’s underwater foundation. If the dam breaks, the loch will pour into the lowlands, flooding the region and crippling dwarven trade and travel.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Earlier today I spotted some Dark Iron Insurgents swimming toward the Dam with a large keg. No Mountaineers were on hand to stop them! I'm afraid they've planted the Seaforium at the base of the Dam and it could blow at any minute! Let me combine all these ingredients into the Disarming Mixture. There we go.
Now I need you to take this mixture and stir it into the keg before it's too late! Hurry!

clips.title: Progress
paras: The top of the keg slowly twists off.

clips.title: Completion
paras: The keg fizzles slightly as the Disarming Mixture settles in.
